---
name: Word or Rhyme Correction
about: Report an incorrect rhyme group, phonetic typo, or misclassification in Darija
title: "[RHYME-DATA]: "
labels: ["data"]
assignees: ""
---

**Target Word(s)**
- Darija (Arabic script): [e.g. دار]
- Darija (Arabizi/Latin): [e.g. dar]
- English Translation: [e.g. house]

**Report Type**
- [ ] Inaccurate Rhyme Matching (Words do not sound like a rhyme)
- [ ] Regional Dialect Difference (e.g. Shamali vs Casawi vs Marrakchi)
- [ ] Spelling / Diacritic Error
- [ ] Inappropriate / Sensitive Word Not Flagged
- [ ] Missing Translation / Meaning

**Suggested Correction**
Explain the natural Moroccan pronunciation and what rhyme ending it should pair with.
